description: UI balancing domain (D-10), REPLAN nested tree (Phase 9A): UI timing plus FX/art tunables (the REPLAN folds FX into ui - no separate vfx domain). Values are the prototype's live tuning, verbatim. Bounds policy: seconds 0-60, pixels -4096-4096.

BuildingColors.description: Swatch fill RGB per master-sheet colour-column NAME (the `columns` list in data/sprites/master_sheets.json). A name with no entry here degrades to a neutral swatch rather than raising, so this map need not be exhaustive, and the whole group is optional.

pink.description: Swatch fill RGB for the 'pink' colour column (new — the shared widgets palette has no pink).

items.description: One RGB channel of the swatch fill, 0..255.

purple.description: Swatch fill RGB for the 'purple' colour column (the shared palette's C_PURPLE).

items.description: One RGB channel of the swatch fill, 0..255.

red.description: Swatch fill RGB for the 'red' colour column (the shared palette's C_RED).

items.description: One RGB channel of the swatch fill, 0..255.

yellow.description: Swatch fill RGB for the 'yellow' colour column (the shared palette's C_GOLD).

items.description: One RGB channel of the swatch fill, 0..255.

Debug.description: Developer/debug visibility toggles. Off by default in shipped data.

show_camera_startpoint.description: If true the camera-startpoint marker sprite is drawn in the running game (grey-X placeholder until art is imported). Default false: the game uses the startpoint only to position the camera and draws nothing for it. Always visible in the editor regardless.

FX.description: Visual FX and background art tunables.

bg_art.description: The hand-painted background art layer under the tile grid.

enabled.description: If true the background art layer draws (canonical flag; was BG_ART_ENABLED + FEATURE_BG_ART).

file.description: Background image filename (resolved against the game's art directory).

offset_x.description: Horizontal offset of the background in world pixels.

offset_y.description: Vertical offset of the background in world pixels.

world_h.description: Background height in world pixels at zoom 1.

world_w.description: Background width in world pixels at zoom 1.

enabled.description: If true the boss announcement banner plays on boss rounds (canonical flag; was FEATURE_BOSS_ANNOUNCEMENT).

hold.description: Banner hold seconds at full opacity.

gore_enabled.description: Master gore toggle: blood splatters and stains (canonical flag; was GORE_ENABLED + FEATURE_BLOOD_STAINS). Also user-facing via the settings menu.

income_floaters_enabled.description: If true income/upkeep floater numbers rise from buildings during the income phase (canonical flag; was FEATURE_INCOME_FLOATERS).

life_lost_anim.description: The lost-life flight: when a life is lost, that HUD life icon flies to screen centre under the LOST 1 LIFE banner, scales up, plays its dying animation row, switches to its dead art and flies home. The hold at centre is NOT tunable here -- it lasts exactly as long as the slot's imported `pressed` row.

center_offset_y.description: Vertical nudge in logical pixels of the centred icon, relative to the bottom of the LOST 1 LIFE line. Positive moves it down.

center_scale.description: Size multiplier applied to the life icon while it sits at screen centre.

fly_back.description: Seconds the icon takes to fly from screen centre back to its HUD position and original size, already showing its dead art.

fly_out.description: Seconds the lost life icon takes to fly from its HUD position to screen centre while scaling up. It still shows its alive art for this leg.

love_counter_anim_duration.description: Seconds the HUD love-pill counter takes to animate from its current displayed value to a new one, whenever state.love changes (spending, cheats, boss bonuses, and each payout beat). Fixed regardless of the size of the change.

Keybindings.description: Default gameplay hotkeys (feature: rebindable hotkeys) - one key string per action, resolved by engine/input.py + game/main.py's `_binding_key_name`. This is the DESIGNER-EDITABLE default; a player's own rebinds persist separately to the gitignored scores/keybindings.json (same shape, validated by data/schemas/keybindings.schema.json) and win over these at boot.

combat_speed_1.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 1x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

combat_speed_2.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 1.5x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

combat_speed_3.description: Sets ENEMY-phase combat speed to 2x. Round-gated inside game/core/session.py; the key is a no-op while locked.

confirm_purchase.description: Confirms whatever construct/move preview modal is currently open - the same effect as clicking its CONFIRM button. No effect when no such modal is open.

end_turn.description: Ends the BUILDING phase early - the dev-convenience keyboard mirror of the End Turn button, gated by the same Session/tutorial checks.

move_down.description: Pans the camera down (WASD). The Down arrow key ALWAYS pans down too, as a fixed always-on alias outside the rebindable set. Held continuously (polled every frame).

move_left.description: Pans the camera left (WASD). The Left arrow key ALWAYS pans left too, as a fixed always-on alias outside the rebindable set. Held continuously (polled every frame).

move_right.description: Pans the camera right (WASD). The Right arrow key ALWAYS pans right too, as a fixed always-on alias outside the rebindable set. Held continuously (polled every frame).

move_up.description: Pans the camera up (WASD). The Up arrow key ALWAYS pans up too, as a fixed always-on alias outside the rebindable set - the numpad/combat-speed precedent - so this binding only ever changes the primary key. Held continuously (polled every frame, not a single KEYDOWN dispatch, like the cutscene hold-to-skip keys).

quick_skip_combat.description: Abandons the current wave straight to ROUND_END, paying no XP for the enemies skipped. Not shown on the in-game Controls screen (a testing convenience, not a player-facing control), but still dispatched through this same binding.

toggle_cheat_menu.description: Opens/closes the cheat menu. Works over the LEVELUP modal, never on GAME_OVER. Not shown on the in-game Controls screen (a hidden dev feature), but still dispatched through this same binding.

toggle_drag_select.description: Toggles the DRAG SEL box-selection mode - the same flag the DRAG SEL HUD button flips on click.

toggle_heatmap.description: Toggles the HEATMAP map overlay - the same flag the HEATMAP HUD pill flips on click.

toggle_range.description: Toggles the RANGE map overlay - the same flag the RANGE HUD pill flips on click.

toggle_tier_overview.description: Toggles the TIERS map overlay - the same flag the TIERS HUD pill flips on click.

zoom_level_1.description: Sets the camera zoom to the 1st (smallest-scale) data-driven zoom level (core.json Camera.zoom_levels, sorted ascending), keeping the viewport-centre world point fixed - the same recentring step_zoom uses.

zoom_level_2.description: Sets the camera zoom to the 2nd data-driven zoom level (core.json Camera.zoom_levels, sorted ascending), keeping the viewport-centre world point fixed. A no-op if fewer than 2 levels are authored.

zoom_level_3.description: Sets the camera zoom to the 3rd (largest-scale) data-driven zoom level (core.json Camera.zoom_levels, sorted ascending), keeping the viewport-centre world point fixed. A no-op if fewer than 3 levels are authored.

Menu.description: Top-level shell/menu tunables (Phase 9H): the intro-cutscene timing.

cutscene_length.description: Seconds the intro cutscene plays before it auto-advances to the main menu (prototype cutscene.py length cap; the decoder running out ends it sooner).

Timing.description: UI interaction timing and layout toggles.

confirm_on_right_side.description: If true the confirm button sits on the right side of the construct preview.

construct_show_cancel.description: If true the construct preview shows a cancel button next to confirm.

not_enough_love_duration.description: Seconds the 'not enough love' flash stays on screen.
